note: Textarea Widget For Text Fields is a single hook_field_widget_info_alter() that adds the 'text' field type to core's text_textarea widget and the 'string' field type to core's string_textarea widget, so short text fields can use a multi-row textarea. NO configure route, no settings form, no config schema, no permissions, no Drush, no plugins. Its only persistent state is the widget 'type' on a field component in an entity_form_display config entity (string_textarea for plain, text_textarea for formatted). Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real form-display config: introspection reads back which widget a short text field uses; execution switches a short text field's widget to the textarea widget, verified against the live entity_form_display.

evals.prompt: On Drupal 11 I have a plain short text field but its edit form only shows a single-line input. Using the textarea_widget_for_text module, how do I let it use a multi-row textarea instead, and where do I change that?
evals.expected_output: Enable the module, then on the bundle's Manage form display change the field's widget from Textfield to 'Text area (multiple rows)' (widget string_textarea for a plain/string field, text_textarea for a formatted/text field).

evals.prompt: Which field types does the textarea_widget_for_text module enable the multi-row textarea widget for, and which core widgets does it extend?
evals.expected_output: It adds the 'string' (plain) field type to core's string_textarea widget and the 'text' (formatted) field type to core's text_textarea widget.

evals.prompt: How does the textarea_widget_for_text module technically make the textarea widget available to short text fields, and could you do the same without the module?
evals.expected_output: It implements hook_field_widget_info_alter(), appending 'text' to text_textarea['field_types'] and 'string' to string_textarea['field_types']. You could replicate it with the same two-line hook in a custom module.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a plain text field field_taw_known that has been set to use a multi-row textarea via the textarea_widget_for_text module. Inspect the live default form display and give the exact widget type (machine name) it uses.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_taw_known component uses widget type string_textarea. Read via drush cget core.entity_form_display.node.article.default content.field_taw_known.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a formatted text field field_taw_fmt whose edit widget is a textarea (enabled by textarea_widget_for_text). Inspect the running form-display config and state the widget type machine name used for that field.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_taw_fmt component uses widget type text_textarea.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a plain text field field_taw_task that currently uses the single-line Textfield widget. Using the textarea_widget_for_text module, change its default form-display widget to the multi-row Text area (string_textarea). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_taw_task component has type=string_textarea (set via Manage form display 'Text area (multiple rows)' or setComponent).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a formatted text field field_taw_body currently using the single-line 'Text field' widget. Use the textarea_widget_for_text module to make its default form-display widget the multi-row Text area (text_textarea). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_taw_body component has type=text_textarea.
